broker_restart_policy: Create a new-epoch RECOVERY_UNKNOWN guard; preserve old terminal records and never use their history as current OS cleanup proof or rearm authority.

channels.endpoint: inherited stdio; fixed WSL distribution/user/executable tuple
channels.server: No socket server; W owns child pipes
guest monitor M via root/systemd-activated listener
root broker B via root/systemd-activated listener

channels.authority: no OS launch in D2; no caller unit/PID/command/property inputs

fresh_generation_policy: No D2 arm/rearm/reset; future separately reviewed administrative allocation after immutable old terminal cleanup and retiring old queues/connections
future_acceptance_cases: Wrong R/M/U peer, substituted tuple/endpoint and inherited control descriptor rejected
Socket activation credential/activation ownership measured, not assumed
D2 start/arm/rearm/reset input refused for every client
Duplicate/concurrent future start cannot create a second invocation
Stop during start suppresses dispatch or stops the tracked late invocation; never RUNNING after stop
Old-G queued stop/dedup reply cannot affect fresh G
Lost cleanup ACK does not become completed stop
Broker/monitor restart or unknown persistence cannot resume/rearm
Successful text rereview does not resolve I1-I7 or authorize host action
later_start_authority: Separate later reviewed administrative action only; not implemented, not client API, not authorized by this revision
old_generation_policy: Well-formed old-G stop is STALE_GENERATION after replacement; compare G at dispatch before cached reply; no effect on current G or liveness
preservation_scope: Original design/review and all existing source files unchanged. Local 221-file/8-ref preservation remains attributed to original review; coordinator did not read those raw files.
rollback_order: Revoke future-start/latch stop; keep B/tracking until confirmed cleanup; then stop M/relay, B and S. Unknown control means quarantine, not guessed signals/destructive removal.
state_edges: later internal one-use fixed-idle action only
same-G stop or bound safety failure
same-G stop; suppress or track/stop in-flight start
exact instance established and no stop latch
same-G stop, owned exit or bound safety failure
recovery/identity/persistence failure or restart uncertainty; old terminal records remain immutable

unresolved_original_blockers.remaining: Prove effective interop/automount denial and alternate-path/inherited-descriptor behavior in a separately authorized fixed test. No claim of proven exploit or isolation.
Exact virtual-account rights, loss/protected/lifetime coverage and host/guest CPU ownership/deduplication are unproven. No privilege fallback or complete-coverage override.
Resolve exact operator/service identities and access masks, service/client peer authentication, independently pinned public key and full pre-enrollment guest bootstrap protocol.

Pin image/source/build/entire installed runtime tree and actual new binary/glibc hashes; proposed distribution/path collisions must be checked before creation. Current private digest is historical, not a new-build pin.

Actual polkit/delegation policy unknown; fixed privileged broker unimplemented. Exact memory headroom, CPU/capacity/accounting values and future official adapter require review; current query-process limits prove none of these.
unresolved_original_blockers.topic: Guest policy/unit limits and controlled launcher

unresolved_original_blockers.remaining: Protected anchor publication/rollback handling and independent control path are unimplemented; specify WSL suspension/restart/supervisor-death semantics without implying a real-time guarantee. Bound journal/log growth for the longest window and establish fresh C: state-store space/parent ACLs; no current capacity or durability claim.
No accepted WSL metadata/container/launcher replacement, host verdict, operator window, worker-tier drill or pre-freeze review. This design does not request OD-R2-0(D).
